author: resepignev
body:
Actyon DTM v1.1




General Information

DTM Pred vs Yorang 20 vs 20

Map Details

Creator:

resepignev

Monuments

Left and Right

Size:

~500 blocks x ~ 120 blocks

Teams:

Pred (20) vs Yorang (20)

Description:

This amazing Destroy The Monument map that spans almost over 500 blocks, features many cool features.

You don't have to craft armor anymore! Mine an iron block and it supplies you with an iron chestplate and leggings.

Do you decide to go for the monument or do you rather try your luck and run behind the enemies spawn to get a diamond sword? Just jump in the boxes and you'll get teleported to your spawn with a shiny diamond sword!

You rather shoot than fight? No problem, check out the sniping spots under the front wings (left and right). There is a big supply full of arrows!

Download List v1.1

World Download v1.1 Pictures YML

Feedback is highly appreciated!

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Congratulations!

Your Map, Actyon, has been accepted for testing!



Here are some Map Developer Comments:

"Looks good, pleasing to the eye, nice block variation, elevation used and it seems like it'll play well. Something that I would add are some structures for cover" - Fouled

"Great map. Simple, but pleasant to the eye. The shape of it is good, and it looks like it'd offer good gameplay. Nothing much to say about it, easy yes" - timaeusTestified

"This map is Simple and looks interesting to play. Players would have to rely on working as a team to reach the monument. Could be another ClayWars stalematey game but it should be fine" - Edans

"could use some more shape" - Xuph

Please add me on Skype (Sethskye) if you have Skype so we can go on further details on Testing or on how to improve this map more or you can find me on The Avicus TeamSpeak.
